claims.claim: The versioned registry covers all 12 required attention families with exact selector schemas, deterministic identities, bounded serialization, and rejection of malformed or substituted contracts.
The transport is selector-only. Regression assertions reject semantic actions, verdicts, correction strategies, roadmap successors, execution profiles, command text, and private browser fields.
RESULT and FAILURE retain existing terminal identities and canonical terminal freshness handling while mapping to semantic-review and correction-reasoning families.
The shared projector distinguishes carrier, review-ingress, and correction-authoring rejection identities. Canonical review follow-up requires CHANGES_REQUIRED or BLOCKED; PASS is excluded.

Dispatch rejection and pre-AIOS failure projections require bounded source provenance and explicit run_created=false. Ordinary progress produces no attention. All three repaired workflows now serialize exact admitted environment delivery selectors without UNATTRIBUTED substitution, retaining attempt-scoped artifacts and 90-day retention.

Publication projections bind exact review, RUN, candidate, and attempt selectors. Publication success remains planning attention until exact canonical reconciliation; conflict attention binds prepared and predecessor identities without choosing replacement work.

Generic attention uses the existing durable lane path with freshness barriers, resolved NOOP handling, lane isolation, generation checks, one-flight ordering, ambiguity no-resend, and permanent duplicate-preserving compaction.
Recovery references an existing unresolved original identity, rejects recursive recovery, creates no second queue subject, and preserves the original when source evidence is unknown.

Retained regression assertions cover progress and privacy exclusions, operational non-fabrication, and absence of semantic routing or downstream activation. Local source collection uses read-only Actions access without self-dispatch.

The committed repair is confined to the four authorized files and preserves the remaining failed candidate. The remediation test retains the intent workflow's legacy artifact name and 30-day retention while asserting the wakeup workflow's attempt-scoped 90-day contract. The bounded Human conformance procedure remains present without claiming live conformance or H4B resume.
